subject: Continue Doré Design through all remaining candidates and converge
body: Continue the Doré Design real-work goal without waiting for user prompts. First recover the current Framesmith westside_project_not_found using evidence-first inspection of actual installed MCP tools/schemas/state and upstream source; do not guess interfaces and do not repeat identical deterministic failures. Run Framesmith through create -> real render -> same-artifact edit -> rerender -> evaluate. If Framesmith has a genuine structural blocker, preserve evidence and immediately proceed to Tela, then Doop, using each provider's actual documented/runtime interface. Penpot remains deferred and OpenPencil remains eliminated for this round. A missing adapter or test harness is INFRASTRUCTURE_GAP, not provider FAIL: build only the thin missing adapter and continue. If all remaining whole providers fail acceptance, use the accumulated source/runtime/failure evidence to compose Doré Design from the useful mature components/patterns (scene graph, persistence, renderer/export, browser viewer, editable layer, verification), implementing only missing Doré-owned layers. Continue until the design capability itself produces a real Westside Watch artifact, second edit, rerender and verification, or until a genuine human-only authorization/irreversible decision is required. Routine failures must enter recovery/fallback automatically; terminal child tasks must not silently terminate the parent goal. Persist work evidence and evolution learning. Promote completed artifact, meaningful milestone, genuine unrecoverable blocker, authorization need, or human decision to user-visible notification; do not require the human to poll for progress.
